available.quote: The board or committee shall issue an expedited license without examination to a dentist or dental hygienist licensed in another licensing jurisdiction if the applicant holds a license that is current and in good standing issued by the other licensing jurisdiction.

requirements.value: Board may issue a general license by credentials to an applicant duly licensed in another state/territory with an active license in good standing for 5 years, no board actions in 5 years prior, no pending proceedings, and no activities in public records that could constitute danger to patients. Alternatively, expedited license issued without examination to any dentist licensed in another jurisdiction with a current, good-standing license, processed within 30 days.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a general license to practice dentistry, by credentials, without a practical or clinical examination to an applicant who is duly licensed by a clinical examination as a dentist under the laws of another state or territory of the United States; provided that license is active and that all dental licenses that individual possesses have been in good standing for five years prior to application.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, treatment, correction, change, relief, prevention, prescription of remedy, surgical operation and adjunctive treatment for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, defect, lesion or physical condition involving both the functional and aesthetic aspects of the teeth, gingivae, jaws and adjacent hard and soft tissue of the oral and maxillofacial regions, including the prescription or administration of any drug, medicine, biologic, apparatus, brace, anesthetic or other therapeutic or diagnostic substance or technique
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, treatment, correction, change, relief, prevention, prescription of remedy, surgical operation and adjunctive treatment for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, defect, lesion or physical condition involving both the functional and aesthetic aspects of the teeth, gingivae, jaws and adjacent hard and soft tissue of the oral and maxillofacial regions, including the prescription or administration of any drug, medicine, biologic, apparatus, brace, anesthetic or other therapeutic or diagnostic substance or technique

value: review of dental insurance claims for therapeutic appropriateness
methods_authorized.quote: perform surgery, an extraction or any other operation or to administer an anesthetic in connection therewith; diagnose or treat a condition, disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, lesion or other physical condition; correct a malposition; treat a fracture; remove calcareous deposits; replace missing anatomy with an artificial substitute; construct, make, furnish, supply, reproduce, alter or repair an artificial substitute or restorative or corrective appliance; give interpretations or readings of dental radiographs; provide limited diagnostic and treatment planning via teledentistry

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe and administer drugs, medicines, biologics, anesthetics and other therapeutic or diagnostic substances as part of dental practice. Dental hygienists may prescribe, administer and dispense fluoride supplements, topically applied fluoride and topically applied antimicrobials under supervision and within a board-approved formulary.
drug_authority.quote: including the prescription or administration of any drug, medicine, biologic, apparatus, brace, anesthetic or other therapeutic or diagnostic substance or technique

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: The board shall establish rules or regulations pertaining to the administration of nitrous oxide analgesia, conscious sedation, deep sedation and general anesthesia by dentists.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The board or its agent may evaluate credentials, facilities, equipment, personnel and procedures prior to issuing permits to allow the administration of agents that are utilized in providing analgesia, sedation or general anesthesia and may re-evaluate the same at its discretion.

specialist_license_available.quote: The board may issue a specialty license by examination to an applicant who has passed a clinical and written examination given by the board or its examining agents that covers the applicant's specialty.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: A specialty license limits the licensee to practice only in that specialty area.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "direct supervision" means the process under which an act is performed when a dentist licensed pursuant to the Dental Health Care Act: (1) is physically present throughout the performance of the act; ... "general supervision" means the authorization by a dentist of the procedures to be used by a dental therapist, community dental health coordinator, dental hygienist, dental assistant or dental student and the execution of the procedures in accordance with a dentist's diagnosis and treatment plan at a time the dentist is not physically present ... "indirect supervision" means that a dentist, or in certain settings, a dental therapist, dental hygienist or dental assistant certified in expanded functions, is present in the treatment facility while authorized treatments are being performed

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: "collaborative dental hygiene practice" means a New Mexico licensed dental hygienist practicing according to Subsections D through G of Section 61-5A-4 NMSA 1978

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A New Mexico licensed dental hygienist may be certified for collaborative dental hygiene practice in accordance with the educational and experience criteria established collaboratively by the committee and the board.

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: The board shall license as a dental therapist any individual who, in accordance with board rules

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist shall provide care in accordance with a dental therapy practice agreement

dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist shall practice only in the following environments: (1) a nonprofit community dental organization; (2) a health facility operated by the federal Indian health service; (3) a health facility that a tribe operates under Section 638 of the federal Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act; (4) a federally qualified health center; (5) a facility certified by the federal centers for medicare and medicaid services as a "federally qualified health center look-alike" facility; (6) a private residence or a facility in which an individual receives long-term community-based services under the state's medicaid program; (7) a long-term care facility; (8) a private residence, when exclusively to treat an individual who, due to disease, disability or condition, is unable to receive care in a dental facility; or (9) an educational institution engaged in the training of dental therapists accredited by the commission on dental accreditation.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Unless licensed as a dentist or non-dentist owner, or as otherwise exempt from the licensing requirements of the Dental Health Care Act, no individual or corporate entity shall: (1) employ or contract with a dentist or dental hygienist for the purpose of providing dental or dental hygiene services

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: "dental laboratory" means any place where dental restorative, prosthetic, cosmetic and therapeutic devices or orthodontic appliances are fabricated, altered or repaired by one or more persons under the orders and authorization of a dentist

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "teledentistry" means a dentist's, dental hygienist's or dental therapist's use of electronic information, imaging and communication technologies, including interactive audio, video and data communications as well as store-and-forward technologies, to provide and support dental health care delivery, diagnosis, consultation, treatment, transfer of dental data and education.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: The board may certify a dental hygienist to administer local anesthetic under the general supervision of a dentist if the dental hygienist, in addition to performing dental hygiene as defined in Subsection B of this section: (1) has administered local anesthesia under the indirect supervision of a dentist for at least two years

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: An expanded-function dental auxiliary may perform the following procedures under the direct supervision of a dentist: (1) placing and shaping direct restorations

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A New Mexico licensed dental hygienist may be certified for collaborative dental hygiene practice in accordance with the educational and experience criteria established collaboratively by the committee and the board.
